cards.assertion: Elevated HbA1c is used to diagnose and monitor type 2 diabetes.
cards.provenanceNote: Clinical practice standard — map to durable locator in evidence sprint.

cards.assertion: Fasting plasma glucose above diagnostic thresholds indicates T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Insulin resistance is a core pathophysiologic feature of T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Progressive β-cell dysfunction contributes to hyperglycemia in T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Metformin is first-line pharmacotherapy for many adults with T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: SGLT2 inhibitors lower glucose and reduce cardiorenal risk in selected T2D patients.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: GLP-1 receptor agonists improve glycemic control and weight in T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Obesity is a major modifiable risk factor for incident T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: CGM time-in-range complements HbA1c for glycemic assessment in T2D.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Systemic glucocorticoids can worsen hyperglycemia and unmask diabetes.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 7569976 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-I010-suppresses-P001 (corticosteroid → NF-κB). HSI hyperglycemia object is not this paper's claim — curator must not approve as hyperglycemia evidence. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: Low-grade chronic inflammation is linked to insulin resistance (immuno-metabolic bridge).
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: TNF-α signalling can impair insulin action in metabolic tissues.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 11244034 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-M001-contributes_to-D001 (TNF → RA). Insulin-resistance object is absent from ISI — not T2D proof. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: Circulating IL-6 is associated with T2D risk and inflammatory tone.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 18625622 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-M003-contributes_to-D001 (IL-6 axis in RA). No Type 2 diabetes node in ISI — not T2D proof. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: hs-CRP is a clinical marker of systemic inflammatory burden.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 12813013 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-P021-produces-B001 (acute-phase → CRP marker). Not a T2D edge. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: Adipose tissue macrophage infiltration associates with insulin resistance.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 2993897 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-C003-produces-M001 (macrophage → TNF). Adipose-tissue macrophage / insulin-resistance pair is not this paper — Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: NLRP3 inflammasome activation contributes to metabolic inflammation.
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 15030775 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-R004-activates-P003 (NLRP3/NALP3 → inflammasome). Metabolic-inflammation object is not a KG node — not T2D proof. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: T2D is associated with increased susceptibility to certain infections.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Sustained hyperglycemia can impair aspects of innate immune function.
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Some autoimmune conditions co-occur with higher T2D risk (bridge shortlist).
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Some irAEs and steroid treatment can present with hyperglycemia (bridge-relevant).
cards.provenanceNote: Phase 0 placeholder — awaiting citation + Gate C review.

cards.assertion: Islet autoantibodies mark autoimmune β-cell targeting in T1D (contrast with T2D).
cards.provenanceNote: PMID 31180194 verified via Europe PMC. Supports ISI related_axis REL-B015-predicts_eligibility_for-I013 (islet autoantibodies → teplizumab eligibility). T1D contrast with T2D clinics — not a T2D edge. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

cards.assertion: LADA can present with adult-onset diabetes phenotypes overlapping T2D clinics.
